answer: Exit-queue deterrence: an identity that wants to withdraw rewards must wait in a queue of 14 epochs, and the queue length grows by 2 epochs for every other identity sharing its funder. A dune of fakes thus freezes capital longer each time, while a lone honest agent barely waits. Validators lit by one lantern of public ledger data recompute queue positions, and a glacier of idle clones gets 25% slashed.
